items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I have a straight baritone sax... that I got from Benny Miroff’s widow from Milwaukee.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I have a straight baritone sax, the only one in the world, that I got from Benny Miroff’s widow from Milwaukee. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
